PPT DS: Air Conditioning Pressure (ACP) Sensor

PPT FF: Power Steering Pressure (PSP) Switch

PPT H: Fuel Control
PPT HA: Natural Gas Fuel Control
PPT HB: Natural Gas Fuel Delivery System
PPT HD: Misfire Detection Monitor

PPT HF: Catalyst Efficiency Monitor and Exhaust Systems
PPT HK: Variable Cam Timing (VCT)
PPT HM: Secondary Air Injection (AIR) System
PPT HU: Intake Air Systems
PPT HX: Evaporative Emission (EVAP) Monitor and System
PPT HY: Generator/Regulator System

PPT JE: Integrated Ignition Coil 1, 2, 3 or 4 Failure
PPT JF: Integrated Ignition Coil On Plug Coil 1 Through 10 Failure

PPT KB: Fuel Pump Driver Module (FPDM)
PPT KC: Fuel Shutoff Valve Relay
PPT KE: Idle Air Control (IAC) Valve

PPT KH: Hydraulic Cooling Fan

PPT KP: Charge Air Cooler Pump (CAC)

PPT QA: Unable To Activate Self-Test/SCP Communication Error/DTC Not Listed

PPT QD: Diagnostic Trouble Code (DTC) P1260

PPT TG: 4x4 Low (4x4L) Range

limits: An exact code mention can be a related or prerequisite code. It does not prove that the page contains that code’s diagnostic tree.
Chart links identify a starting section or state-specific route. A complete diagnosis may require other referenced tests, workshop manuals, connectors, engine applicability and later revisions.
The description page contains actual diagnostic fields, but those fields and complete test prose have not been copied into this metadata artifact.
All 54 discovered pinpoint destinations were retrieved; HTTP success and an existing anchor are not a technical review.
Existing dictionary titles may conflict with historical source descriptions. Verify the exact namespace, model year and module before authoring.
This catalog is research progress, not 10,000 articles, a complete Ford manual acquisition or proof of repairs for modern vehicles.
